_notes: fk_downsize_load_kit DOWNSIZELOAD v1. enabled=true: glb PNG/JPEG images whose short side >= minSize are decoded at 1/2^k per axis (k = glbMipDrop of the active memory_tiers.json preset, or dropOverride, or -dlmip:N), via the TexDedupe import addon (embedded images) and ZoneDecode (externalised images). The full-size texture is destroyed in the same call (peak resident full-size = 1). presets = preset names it may run on (empty = any preset with glbMipDrop > 0; High has 0 so it never runs). minOut = smallest output short side. method gpu = halving blits in linear light then ReadPixels, cpu = job box average. renormalizeNormals re-normalises detected normal maps. compress = Texture2D.Compress(false) on the reduced texture only when w*h <= compressMaxPixels (CPU cost, default off). One-row revert: enabled false (applies to the next glb load). Switch: -downsizeload:on / -downsizeload:off, -dlmip:N.
